experiment: P3 GenImage official SDv1.4 ZIP to Arrow conversion
root_cause: dict.setdefault evaluated ZipFile(record.source_path) for every row, reopening and rescanning the 336000-entry central directory even when the archive handle was already cached.
fix: Use dict.get and construct one ZipFile handle only on the first record for each archive; close cached handles after iteration.
regression_test: The ZIP row iterator now asserts that two members from one archive open ZipFile exactly once.
retry_policy: Restart from row zero with a new datasets cache directory and the same frozen source plan.
